chunks: Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl narrated from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
The hastening in Wādī Muḥassir is one hundred steps.

key_terms.الْحَرَكَةُ: the hastening or movement performed in the rite
key_terms.خُطْوَةٍ: steps; the unit used to define the distance
key_terms.مُحَسِّرٍ: Muḥassir, the specific valley mentioned in the hajj rites
key_terms.مِائَةُ: one hundred, the numerical measure stated in the hadith
key_terms.وَادِي: valley; the location where this ritual act is performed

ai.seo_question: How much should one hasten in Wādī Muḥassir during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal description of the prescribed hastening in Wādī Muḥassir during hajj rites. It specifies the measure of that movement as one hundred steps, indicating a defined ritual practice within the manāsik.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2988 - Muhammad ibn Isma'il narrated from Abu al-Hasan (as), who said:
"The hastening in the Valley of Muhassir is a distance of one hundred steps."
